verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a mobile app, but nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out for GitHub Mobile. The only related setting is a Copilot option to allow or block suggestions that match public code, which is a different control and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
